# OsumFix Technical Services LLC - Dubai

> Premier Property Maintenance, HVAC Repair, Plumbing, Electrical, and Technical Services in Dubai, UAE.

OsumFix Technical Services LLC provides 24/7 emergency repair and annual maintenance contracts (AMC) for residential villas, apartments, commercial offices, and retail spaces across Dubai.

## Key Services

- [AC Repair & Maintenance](https://www.osumfix.com/services/ac-work): Comprehensive AC repair, chemical coil washing, gas refilling, duct cleaning, and compressor troubleshooting.
- [Licensed Electrical Work](https://www.osumfix.com/services/electrical-work): DB box troubleshooting, short-circuit repairs, switch and lighting installations, and DEWA-compliant villa rewiring.
- [Emergency Plumbing Work](https://www.osumfix.com/services/plumbing-work): Acoustic leak detection, water heater repair & installation, drain jetting, booster pump servicing, and sanitary fitting.
- [Interior & Exterior Painting](https://www.osumfix.com/services/painting-work): Wall sanding, anti-fungal priming, villa exterior weatherproofing, and premium Jotun interior painting.
- [Masonry & Civil Work](https://www.osumfix.com/services/masonry-work): Precision ceramic & porcelain tiling, wall plastering, interlock paving, and bathroom waterproofing.
- [Carpentry Work](https://www.osumfix.com/services/carpentry-work): Custom wardrobe & cabinet fabrication, door lock fitting, deck polishing, and furniture repair.
- [Steel Fixing & Reinforcement](https://www.osumfix.com/services/steel-fixing): Structural rebar tying, foundation reinforcement, and beam steel cage installation.
- [Interior Designing & Fit-Out](https://www.osumfix.com/services/interior-designing): 2D/3D space planning, commercial fit-out execution, lighting design, and decorative wall paneling.
- [False Ceiling & Gypsum Work](https://www.osumfix.com/services/ceiling-gypsum): Gypsum board false ceiling installation, LED cove lighting channels, and acoustic partition walls.
- [24/7 Handyman Services](https://www.osumfix.com/services/handyman-services): TV wall bracket mounting, curtain rod hanging, mirror installation, and IKEA furniture assembly.
